Elliot: 'Always bring extra chargers.' coffee.
Priya: 'Send snacks, not spreadsheets.' coffee + oat milk.
Miguel: 'Laugh loudly, ship quietly.' tea.
Zoe: One-liner: 'Socks first, shoes later.' coffee.
Ken: 'Commit small, iterate daily.' tea.
SnackBot: Poll created: Coffee vs Tea. React with :coffee: or :tea:.
Maya: 'Reply fast, apologize slower.' coffee. Also :coffee: cast.
Sam: 'Ask questions, assume curiosity.' tea.
Priya: side note: shoutout to Maya for rescuing the build earlier 389
Maya: thanks! was a team effort, but extra :sparkles: for Miguel's debug script.
Miguel: hehe team effort indeed. Also here's a tiny gif to celebrate: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-small-3o7abB06u9bNzA8LuU
SnackBot: Poll results: Coffee 4 votes, Tea 3 votes. Coffee wins.
Noor: Winners get first round of the communal coffee stash tomorrow. Losers bring biscotti. Deal?
Elliot: Deal. Biscotti is a fair bribe.
Ken: I'll bring biscotti AND a one-liner book.
Sam: I'll bring the sympathy biscotti if my tea team loses.
Noor: Perfect. Tiny morale win for the Friday afternoon. Thanks y'all :heart:
